subtitle: We'll read the lines of destiny inscribed in your palm
analyzing: Reading the destiny held in your palm lines
instruction.showPalm: Open your palm and hold it up to the camera
instruction.lighting: Make sure palm lines are visible in bright lighting
instruction.fullPalm: Ensure your entire palm fits within the frame
handSizeOmen.large.0: Large hands signify great ambition — a wide palm is a vessel for gathering wealth and embracing the world.
handSizeOmen.large.1: In palmistry, a broad palm is the sign of a leader who gathers wealth and commands respect.
handSizeOmen.large.2: These are the hands of a natural leader — a wide palm broadens your sphere of influence.
handSizeOmen.medium.0: Harmonious hands foretell a balanced life, bridging ideals and reality without excess.
handSizeOmen.medium.1: Well-proportioned hands carry practical wisdom — you excel in any field you pursue.
handSizeOmen.medium.2: Capable hands with evenly distributed energy — a stable and fulfilling life awaits.
handSizeOmen.small.0: Delicate hands are gifted in fine work — artistic sensibility and keen intuition dwell within. Great value is found in the smallest things.
handSizeOmen.small.1: Clever, nimble hands that seize opportunities before others — wit and resourcefulness abound.
handSizeOmen.small.2: Compact hands with refined senses — you shine in precision work and creative pursuits.
fingerOmen.ringDominant.0: Long ring fingers indicate strong decisiveness and action — you thrive in competitive arenas.
fingerOmen.ringDominant.1: Ring finger dominance is the mark of a doer — achievement comes through practice, not planning alone.
fingerOmen.ringDominant.2: An adventurous spirit resides in these hands — opportunity awaits in new challenges and change.
fingerOmen.indexDominant.0: Long index fingers signal strong leadership — self-assurance and the power to guide others dwell within.
fingerOmen.indexDominant.1: Index finger dominance reflects ambition and conviction — you advance toward lofty goals without wavering.
fingerOmen.indexDominant.2: A leader's energy is etched in your fingers — you naturally become the center of any organization.
fingerOmen.balanced.0: Balanced fingers reflect a harmonious nature — reason and emotion unite, creating excellent rapport with all.
fingerOmen.balanced.1: Even finger proportions bring accurate judgment and the wisdom of moderation — you never fall to extremes.
fingerOmen.balanced.2: The mark of balance — composure and warmth coexist in every situation.
palmOmen.long.0: A long palm carries strong intuition — your inner senses are acute, and premonitions often prove true. Scholarly and contemplative talent resides within.
palmOmen.long.1: An elongated palm reveals deep thinking and far-reaching vision. Rich artistic sensibility flows through you.
palmOmen.long.2: A palm imbued with Water energy — deep emotion and wisdom make you shine in creative fields.
palmOmen.square.0: A square palm carries Earth energy — practical and grounded, you achieve stable success in worldly affairs.
palmOmen.square.1: A stable palm that inspires trust — exceptional organizational skill and systematic thinking are your strengths.
palmOmen.square.2: A square palm is the mark of steadfast will — you fulfill every responsibility entrusted to you.
palmOmen.balanced.0: A harmonious palm balances the ideal and the real — versatile talent that masters many fields.
palmOmen.balanced.1: Flexible hands that adapt to any situation — the energy of transformation resides within.
palmOmen.balanced.2: Well-proportioned palm — stability that doesn't shy away from challenge.
line.lifeLine.name: Life Line
line.lifeLine.desc: The curved line from between thumb and index finger to the wrist — represents vitality, health, and life changes
line.headLine.name: Head Line
line.headLine.desc: The horizontal line across the mid-palm — represents intellectual ability and decision-making style
line.heartLine.name: Heart Line
line.heartLine.desc: The horizontal line just below the fingers — represents emotional stability and relationship tendencies
line.fateLine.name: Fate Line
line.fateLine.desc: The vertical line in the center of the palm — represents career path, external influences, and social achievement
lineOmen.lifeLine.strong: Your life line runs deep and clear, sweeping around the thumb with strong curvature — you were born with robust vitality. Its excellent continuity foretells longevity and resilience through life's changes.
lineOmen.lifeLine.clear: A distinct life line speaks of overflowing energy. The smooth flow of this line promises a vibrant life through middle age.
lineOmen.lifeLine.moderate: A moderately etched life line suggests steady health that benefits from consistent care. Regular habits will strengthen your fortune.
lineOmen.lifeLine.faint: A faint life line calls for building a strong health foundation. Regular exercise and ample rest will revitalize your life energy.
lineOmen.lifeLine.unclear: The life line is hard to discern — open your palm wider under bright light and try again.
lineOmen.headLine.strong: Your head line runs deep and long across the palm — exceptional wisdom and keen analytical powers were bestowed upon you. Great scholarly achievement and flawless decision-making lie ahead.
lineOmen.headLine.clear: A clear head line reveals a brilliant mind with strong logical reasoning. Your plans are precise and your judgment sound.
lineOmen.headLine.moderate: A moderately etched head line suggests practical wisdom that navigates reality well. Wisdom deepens through experience.
lineOmen.headLine.faint: A faint head line suggests reliance on intuition over logic. Emotion leads before reason — artistic temperament may flourish.
lineOmen.headLine.unclear: The head line is hard to discern — improve the lighting and open your palm fully to try again.
lineOmen.heartLine.strong: Your heart line runs deep and long beneath the fingers — deep affection and wholehearted devotion reside within. Its pronounced curvature brings emotional richness that blesses your relationships.
lineOmen.heartLine.clear: A clear heart line reveals a warm heart with emotional stability. Rich and meaningful connections shall grace your life.
lineOmen.heartLine.moderate: A moderately etched heart line shows well-balanced emotions. Reason and feeling coexist in harmony.
lineOmen.heartLine.faint: A faint heart line suggests difficulty expressing emotions. Opening your heart honestly will deepen your bonds.
lineOmen.heartLine.unclear: The heart line is hard to discern — relax your hand fully and try again.
lineOmen.fateLine.strong: Your fate line rises deep and clear from the wrist toward the middle finger — you are destined for great achievement. A firmly established career path brings significant social success.
lineOmen.fateLine.clear: A vivid fate line reveals clear purpose. Walk your chosen path with unwavering dedication and you shall surely shine.
lineOmen.fateLine.moderate: A moderately etched fate line says you are still finding your way. When the time comes, your direction will become crystal clear.
lineOmen.fateLine.faint: A faint fate line suggests a free spirit who resists convention. Your own choices, not external forces, shape your destiny.
lineOmen.fateLine.unclear: The fate line is hard to find — your destiny is yet unwritten. Forge it yourself without fear.
mainMessage.strongLines: The four major palm lines (Heart, Head, Life, Fate) are vivid and clear — born under a strong fortune. Their depth and continuity overflow with blessings.
mainMessage.detectedLines: Reading your palm reveals auspicious energy. The harmony of Heart, Head, and Life lines is favorable — live according to the destiny inscribed in your hands.
mainMessage.default.0: Auspicious energy flows through your hands. The smooth flow of your palm lines holds fortune and blessings.
mainMessage.default.1: Reading the destiny in your hands — the energy of heaven's favor lingers within.
mainMessage.default.2: These are precious hands — blessings dwell in everything they touch.
mainMessage.default.3: Good energy lingers in your palm — the future is bright.
mainMessage.largeSqaure: Large hands with a square palm — strong Earth energy brings wealth and authority.
mainMessage.indexLong: A leader's spirit combined with deep contemplation — strong index energy destines you for great endeavors.
mainMessage.smallLong: Delicate and sensitive hands — imbued with Water energy, you shall shine in art and creation.
advice.0: Keep your hands clean and nails tidy — clarity of hand energy amplifies fortune.
advice.1: The left hand reveals your born destiny (innate fortune), the right hand the one you create (acquired fortune) — cherish both.
advice.2: Spread your hands often in sunlight — Yang energy gathers and blocked fortune opens.
advice.3: Gently massage your palms to improve blood flow — the energy of your life line will strengthen.
advice.lifeLineFaint: Your life line is faint — boost your vitality through regular exercise and ample rest. The life line deepens with effort.
advice.headLineStrong: Your head line is strong — pursue scholarly or research endeavors for great intellectual achievement. Put your sharp analytical mind to use.
advice.heartLineStrong: Your heart line runs deep — express your genuine feelings to loved ones, and bonds will deepen even further.
advice.fateLineNotDetected: Your fate line is faint — your own will, not external influences, shapes your destiny. Move forward without fear and forge your own path.
